text: {"assertions":["An infinite recursion bug was discovered in graph/traversal/walker.rs on 2026-01-07 in the graph engine.","The infinite recursion manifested only for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy.","The bug could be reproduced by walking the cyclic fixture graph.","The root cause was a mutable default argument that was shared across multiple function calls.","The symptom was an ever-growing stack until the guard mechanism tripped and caused a stack overflow.","The fix involved making the default argument empty and building the value per call (PR #1517 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-1).","The backlog cleared 70 minutes after the fix was deployed.","This infinite recursion issue occurred in the same code location as previous infinite recursion work."]}
